name: Multi-Specialty & Tertiary Hospitals
summary: Full-service multi-specialty and tertiary teaching hospitals in Dubai providing 24/7 emergency departments, intensive care units (ICU/NICU), inpatient surgical suites, blood banks, and advanced diagnostic imaging.
dhaStandards: Must maintain 24/7 emergency medicine, continuous in-house consultant coverage, accredited pharmacy services, and NABIDH electronic health system integration.

faqs.q: What accreditation standards do Dubai private hospitals follow?
faqs.a: Dubai private hospitals are accredited by international bodies such as Joint Commission International (JCI), Australian Healthcare Standards (ACHSI), or Canadian Healthcare Standards (AC), alongside DHA regulatory licensure.

faqs.q: Do private hospitals in Dubai accept emergency walk-in patients?
faqs.a: Yes, all licensed hospitals with emergency departments accept urgent and critical walk-in patients 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

name: Specialty Clinics & Polyclinics
summary: Outpatient medical clinics and polyclinics offering specialist doctor consultations, routine diagnostic workups, day-case monitoring, and preventative health checks with shorter wait times and personalized care.
dhaStandards: Must feature dedicated consultation rooms, clinical treatment rooms, automated external defibrillators (AED), and DHA-licensed nursing staff.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a polyclinic and a hospital in Dubai?
faqs.a: A polyclinic focuses on outpatient consultations, minor procedures, and daytime investigations without overnight inpatient hospital admissions.

faqs.q: Can polyclinics in Dubai perform minor surgeries?
faqs.a: DHA-licensed polyclinics can perform minor outpatient procedures under local anesthesia (wound suturing, mole excisions, joint injections).

name: Diagnostic Pathology Laboratories
summary: Specialized laboratory facilities accredited by CAP and ISO-15189, offering routine biochemistry, molecular PCR genetics, hormone panels, microbiology, and mobile home sample collection across Dubai.
dhaStandards: Must participate in international external quality assessment schemes (EQAS), employ licensed clinical laboratory scientists, and operate verified cold-chain logistics.

faqs.q: Are laboratory test results in Dubai integrated into my digital medical file?
faqs.a: Yes, through the DHA NABIDH platform, licensed diagnostic laboratories automatically sync verified test reports directly to your unified electronic medical record.

faqs.q: Can I book home phlebotomy directly through diagnostic laboratories?
faqs.a: Yes, licensed diagnostic labs dispatch certified mobile phlebotomists for convenient home sample collection with digital results delivered within hours.

name: Home Healthcare & Nursing Providers
summary: Accredited home healthcare agencies providing doctor house calls, skilled clinical nurses, post-operative rehabilitation, elderly daily assistance, and at-home infusion treatments in patient residences.
dhaStandards: Requires dedicated DHA Home Healthcare licensure, continuous nurse clinical supervision by a licensed medical director, and emergency transfer protocols.

faqs.q: Can doctors prescribe medication during a home visit in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, DHA-licensed home healthcare physicians can conduct physical examinations, prescribe medications via digital e-Rx, and arrange laboratory testing on-site.

faqs.q: How can I book an at-home nursing service in Dubai?
faqs.a: You can request home nursing by specifying the required hours (4, 12, or 24-hour shifts) and medical requirements through our direct booking portal or WhatsApp.
